SELECTED_INDEX: 7
CONFIDENCE: 0.72
EXPLANATION: The weak band at 2743 cm⁻¹ is highly diagnostic for an aldehyde C–H stretch (Fermi-resonance region), and among the candidates only 7 (CC(C)(CC=O)C(N)=O) contains an aldehyde. The broad features at 3208–3418 cm⁻¹ and bands at 1690 and 1627 cm⁻¹ are consistent with an amide N–H stretch and amide I/II (GFQ-001/002), matching the –C(N)=O group in 7. The strong cluster of aliphatic C–H stretches at 2930–2991 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and CH bending near 1458/1446 also fit the saturated, branched alkyl framework in 7. Nitro-specific signatures expected for candidate 1 (distinct strong ~1550–1600 and ~1325 cm⁻¹ pair) are not convincingly present, making 7 the best match.
